idea: labeler comparison, 20 seeds, soft labels, no guidance
takeaway: all labelers below Jev; almost never predict 'very positive' (32/34 gold 4s -> 3)

idea: SST-convention guidance v1 written from dev-half-A labeler errors
takeaway: biggest lever: guidance fixes under-use of 'very positive'; deepseek-flash best and cheap

idea: stronger labeler deepseek-v4-pro with guidance v1
takeaway: 7x the price, no gain over deepseek-flash

idea: average deepseek-flash and qwen soft labels
takeaway: weaker second labeler dilutes

idea: blend v1 seeded silver labels (w=0.2) into deepseek guidance-v1 soft labels
change: dev items covered by v1 silver
takeaway: +0.017 on 117 items is noise; not used

idea: per-class log-bias calibration of labeler (5-fold CV on dev)
change: additive log-bias tuned on dev folds
takeaway: helps labeler argmax slightly; not applied to students (no gain there)

idea: label full pool with deepseek-flash + guidance v1 + seeds, soft
takeaway: full pool labeled cheaply thanks to provider prompt caching

idea: gte-modernbert on v1 seeded hard silver (4.9k)
takeaway: v1-style labels give a sub-Jev student

idea: gte-modernbert soft vs hard targets on guidance-v1 labels
takeaway: soft targets help (+0.035 single run)

idea: gte-modernbert HPO/seeds (lr 2e-5..5e-5, 3-5 epochs, 3 seeds, mean pooling)
takeaway: seed noise +-0.02; gte plateaus ~0.56

idea: add 220 gold (x3) to gte training, 2-fold cross-fit on dev
takeaway: no clear gain

idea: 3.5k SST-style sub-phrases from pool sentences, teacher-labeled
takeaway: phrase-level transfer data did not help the sentence-level student

idea: student bias calibration (dev CV, or matching teacher on silver val)
takeaway: no consistent gain

idea: UltraBERT backbone, soft labels
takeaway: UltraBERT +0.05 over gte on this task

idea: 2-model UltraBERT prob ensembles
takeaway: noise-level gain; would double latency

idea: full dynamic int8 (gte / UltraBERT)
takeaway: int8 breaks UltraBERT and costs gte 0.05

idea: partial int8: keep MLP down_proj, attention-score MatMuls and head in fp32
takeaway: UltraBERT int8 works when down_proj stays fp32; p95 ~28 ms

idea: UltraBERT fp32 ONNX / torch latency
takeaway: fp32 UltraBERT fails the 70 ms gate

idea: partial int8: quantise only attention projections
takeaway: accurate but misses the gate

idea: round-1 frozen recipe: UltraBERT seed1 + partial int8
takeaway: test parity with Jev (see final.json)

idea: guidance v2 written from remaining labeler errors on dev half A
takeaway: overfits the half it was written on: +0.04 on A, -0.05 on held-out B

idea: self-consistency: 4 samples of deepseek-flash guidance v1 at T=0.7, averaged
takeaway: sampled labels are individually worse and averaging does not beat the greedy T=0 label

idea: uniform weight soup of 3 UltraBERT seeds (same recipe)
takeaway: backbone soup keeps ranking but the averaged head is miscalibrated across classes (class 3 collapses)

idea: soup of 3 UltraBERT seeds + linear head refit on silver soft labels (no gold)
change: LR on soup CLS embeddings of 7.9k pool texts, soft targets via weighted replication
takeaway: soup + head refit beats the single-seed mean by ~0.017 at no inference cost (noise-level on 200)

idea: batch labeling, 20 sentences per call (soft percentages)
takeaway: 8x cheaper but each labeler loses 0.03-0.06 accuracy on SST-5; useful only as a second, diverse opinion

idea: 2-labeler soft-label averages on dev (per-item flash v1 + second labeler)
takeaway: second opinion adds ~+0.02 on dev (noise-level); flash+haiku batched is the only affordable one for the pool

idea: second labeling pass of full pool: claude-haiku-5.5, batched 20/call, seeds, no guidance
takeaway: affordable second opinion thanks to batching; value judged by the student (separate line)

idea: UltraBERT on averaged soft labels: deepseek-flash per-item + haiku batched
takeaway: batched haiku second opinion does not transfer to the student (mean -0.02); under-predicts very positive

idea: 2 more UltraBERT seeds (3,4) of the round-1 recipe
takeaway: round-1 recipe single-model dev mean 0.603, sd ~0.013

idea: 5-seed UltraBERT soup + silver head refit, deployed with partial int8
change: soup5 (seeds 0-4) -> LR head on flash soft labels -> nodown partial int8
takeaway: removes seed-selection variance (+0.017 over the fp32 seed mean) but vs the round-1 frozen model the gain is +0.005, far inside dev noise; not re-scored

idea: round-2 re-score decision
takeaway: no round-2 recipe beats round 1 on dev beyond noise, so test was not re-scored (policy)

idea: round-3 decision
takeaway: no labeler clears the bar; no pool relabel, no retrain, no test re-score. SST-5 gold agreement plateaus ~0.56-0.60 for all LLMs incl. frontier

idea: 8-thread latency of round-1 model and a 2-model UltraBERT partial-int8 ensemble
takeaway: 8 threads allow a 2-model UltraBERT ensemble under 70 ms

idea: 2-model ensembles of partial-int8 UltraBERT seeds (prob average)
takeaway: ensembling students trained on the same labels does not help: shared label noise dominates

idea: ModernBERT-large (395M) student, soft deepseek-flash labels, max_len 80
change: backbone swap; lr 2e-5 seeds 0-2, lr 1e-5 seed 0
takeaway: a 2.6x larger student does not exceed its labels; mean below UltraBERT-150M

idea: ModernBERT-large on averaged soft labels (deepseek-flash + batched haiku)
takeaway: second labeler adds nothing for the large student either

idea: ModernBERT-large int8 latency at 8 threads (loaded machine, load avg ~25)
change: onnx int8 (lib default keeps MLP out fp32)
takeaway: fails the gate under load; moot since accuracy did not improve

idea: shared-init soup: 4 continuations (1 epoch, lr 1e-5, different data orders) of UltraBERT seed 1, weight-averaged
takeaway: shared-init soup works (no collapse, 0.625 fp32) but the gain vanishes after partial int8; fp32 CI still includes 0

idea: fp32 ONNX UltraBERT at 8 threads
takeaway: fp32 UltraBERT still misses 70 ms p95 on the loaded machine even with 8 threads

idea: relaxed-setting decision
takeaway: nothing clears dev noise vs the round-1 frozen model; test not re-scored

idea: post-hoc calibration
change: temperature scaling T=1.484 on deployed partial-int8 probs, fit on 200 dev (5-fold CV over none/temperature/vector/isotonic)
takeaway: raw student is overconfident (dev conf 0.70 vs acc 0.60); T=1.48 fixes it; test ECE 0.110->0.034 vs Jev raw 0.170 (Jev oracle 0.036); argmax unchanged

idea: batch-1 serving consistency
change: recompute deployed partial-int8 probs at batch size 1; refit temperature on batch-1 dev
takeaway: 5.1% test argmax flips; test acc 0.580 (batch1) vs 0.583 (batched) vs Jev 0.579: tie either way; calibrated ECE 0.034
